scope: Before native feature access. Actual deployed-rate diagnostic only; not a promotable model, contrast or endpoint.
method: After common-metric nomination, freeze winning overall arm's first registered seed 6101 (no search); target its four FIT hard-symbol frequencies sorted descending. Using hero_rule.fit_control(V,'random_affine',mass=target) form one alternative quantile cut of the already registered frozen random affine scalar. Use its achieved hard distribution and H, not nominal K, in a secondary comparison to the same winning seed. Fixed registration cannot force exact rate under ties. Fresh identical critic calibration on winner's law at its selected depth and seed. Existing six controls, both objectives, three starts remain mandatory at screening depth. This calibration cannot change category selection, nominee, rule or deployment.
execution: Single BLAS thread/process; max 3 independent jobs concurrently as authorized. No dynamics, test-data tuning or additional models.
